Bay County

A Panama City Firm, Not a Statewide Call Center

The Price Law Firm operates from 2633 W. 23rd St. in Panama City, and Bay County is home ground. We know the intersections where crashes cluster, the stretch of Highway 231 that carries freight north out of town, and the way summer traffic on 23rd Street and Tyndall Parkway changes the risk picture.

Bay County has been through a great deal — hurricane recovery brought years of heavy construction traffic, commercial trucking, and out-of-town drivers unfamiliar with local roads. That has left a steady stream of serious collisions, and a steady stream of insurance adjusters trying to settle them cheaply.

We handle trucking accidents, auto accidents, catastrophic injuries, product liability and insurance disputes. What you will not get here is a case manager you have never met. Bill Price handles the file himself.

If you have been injured in Panama City, call 850-215-2195. The consultation is free, and it costs nothing to find out where you stand.

Where Panama City Cases Are Filed

Bay County is part of the 14th Judicial Circuit of Florida.

Bay County Courthouse
300 East 4th Street, Panama City, FL 32401

The 14th Judicial Circuit also covers Calhoun, Gulf, Holmes, Jackson and Washington counties. Most Bay County civil injury claims are filed and heard here.

We are at 2633 W. 23rd St., Panama City, FL 32405, on W. 23rd Street. Parking is available on site, and the Bay County Courthouse is a short drive away at 300 East 4th Street.

Bay County sits within Florida's 14th Judicial Circuit, which also covers Calhoun, Gulf, Holmes, Jackson and Washington counties. Most civil injury claims arising in Bay County are filed at the Bay County Courthouse in Panama City.

Which division hears the case depends on the amount in controversy and the type of claim. The great majority of injury claims settle without ever reaching a courtroom.

Nothing. The initial consultation is free and carries no obligation to hire the firm. Injury cases are handled on a contingency fee — the fee comes out of any recovery rather than being billed to you along the way, and there is no fee unless we win.
